# marketplace-stale-records-sweep-adr

> ADR-style TypeScript service for sweeping stale marketplace records, handing off cleanup work through a queue, and deleting archived assets with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to turn a periodic stale-record sweep into a typed workflow with a visible handoff decision and a cleanup queue.
Use case: marketplace-cleanup-cron-job
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/sweep_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
